scholarships.name: CM Punjab Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.who: Punjab domicile students who started a selected degree in 2026 at a listed institute
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition fees (50,000 new awards in this phase)
scholarships.deadline: 19 November 2026

scholarships.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarships
scholarships.who: Pakistani students in financial need studying 4-5 year undergraduate programmes at HEC-selected public universities
scholarships.coverage: University fee + Rs 6,000 per month for the complete programme
scholarships.deadline: Har university ki apni last date hoti hai — apni university ke Financial Aid Office se check karein

scholarships.name: BEEF Out of Province Scholarships (Balochistan)
scholarships.who: Balochistan domicile students with 60% marks / 3.00 GPA studying at public institutions outside Balochistan
scholarships.coverage: Annual stipend (partial support)
scholarships.deadline: Applications open hain — closing date abhi publish nahi hui

scholarships.name: HEC BISP Undergraduate Scholarships (formerly Ehsaas)
scholarships.who: Newly admitted needy students at public-sector universities (merit + financial need)
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fee + Rs 40,000 per year
scholarships.deadline: Abhi band hai — naya schedule announce nahi hua

scholarships.name: PEEF Scholarships (Punjab Educational Endowment Fund)
scholarships.who: Punjab domicile, at least 60% marks, family income Rs 60,000/month or less, full-time at a partner institution
scholarships.coverage: Stipend paid twice a year till degree completion (partial)
scholarships.deadline: 2026-27 ka schedule abhi announce nahi hua

scholarships.name: SEEF Scholarships (Sindh Educational Endowment Fund)
scholarships.who: Sindh domicile needy and meritorious students at SEEF-approved institutions
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition fee for one academic year (renewable)
scholarships.deadline: August 2027 mein nayi applications expected hain

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.who: Pakistani students resident in Pakistan who cannot afford UK study; first degree at least 2:1; apply via a participating UK university
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, airfare and monthly stipend (£1,712/month, £2,000 in London)
scholarships.deadline: 8 December 2026

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship (UK)
scholarships.who: Students from outside the UK (including Pakistan) applying for a full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge
scholarships.coverage: Full cost — tuition, maintenance, airfare and visa/health charges
scholarships.deadline: 8 December 2026 ya 6 January 2027 — course par munhasir hai

scholarships.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.who: Non-French students including Pakistanis — a French university applies on your behalf (students cannot apply directly)
scholarships.coverage: Monthly allowance + travel, insurance and housing support (tuition NOT covered)
scholarships.deadline: 6 January 2027 (universities ke through)

scholarships.name: HEC US-Pakistan Knowledge Corridor PhD Scholarship
scholarships.who: Pakistani/AJK citizens with confirmed admission at a Top-100 QS US university; GRE 300+ or HAT 60%+
scholarships.coverage: Full (Top-50 universities) / partial (51-100) — tuition, stipend, insurance, airfare
scholarships.deadline: 30 March 2027

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) via HEC
scholarships.who: Pakistani/AJK citizens; apply on BOTH HEC and CSC portals (Type A, Agency No. 5861); entry test score 50+ required
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, dormitory, monthly stipend and medical insurance (airfare not included)
scholarships.deadline: Applications open hain — HEC ki last date abhi announce nahi hui (ETC test registration 22 November 2026 tak)

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Europe)
scholarships.who: Students worldwide including Pakistan with a Bachelor degree (or in final year); apply directly to the programme
scholarships.coverage: Full for scholarship holders — fees, travel, visa and €1,400/month living allowance
scholarships.deadline: Har programme ki apni date — zyada tar December 2026 / January 2027 tak band hoti hain

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS Scholarship (Germany)
scholarships.who: Graduates from developing countries including Pakistan with at least 2 years professional experience; EPOS-listed courses only
scholarships.coverage: €992/month (Master) or €1,400/month (PhD) + insurance and travel allowance
scholarships.deadline: Har course ki apni date — zyada tar October-December 2026

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
scholarships.who: Non-Korean students including Pakistanis (Embassy and University tracks)
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, airfare, 1-year Korean language training and monthly allowance
scholarships.deadline: University Track ki dates har university ki alag hain; Graduate (GKS-G) February 2027 mein expected

scholarships.name: Turkiye Burslari Scholarship
scholarships.who: Non-Turkish citizens including Pakistanis meeting the level criteria
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, stipend, accommodation, airfare, health insurance and 1-year Turkish course
scholarships.deadline: 10 January - 20 February 2027 (expected — har saal yahi schedule hota hai)

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship (Hungary) via HEC
scholarships.who: Pakistani citizens nominated by HEC; apply on BOTH the Hungarian and HEC portals
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, housing contribution, stipend, health insurance and travel contribution
scholarships.deadline: Applications jald khulengi — aam tor par January mein band hoti hain

scholarships.name: Fulbright Scholarship Pakistan (USA)
scholarships.who: Pakistani citizens resident in Pakistan; 16 years education for Master, 18 years for PhD; GRE required
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, books, airfare, living stipend, health insurance and visa
scholarships.deadline: February 2027 mein dobara khulengi (2027 wali applications band ho chuki hain)

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship (UK)
scholarships.who: Pakistani citizens with a completed degree and at least 2,800 hours of work experience
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, monthly stipend, airfare and arrival allowances
scholarships.deadline: August 2027 mein dobara khulengi

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.who: Pakistani citizens resident in Pakistan with 16 years education and at least 5 years work experience (Master only for Pakistan)
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, airfare, establishment allowance, living costs and health cover
scholarships.deadline: February 2027 mein dobara khulengi

scholarships.name: MEXT Scholarship (Japan)
scholarships.who: Pakistani nationals applying through the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.coverage: Full — tuition, monthly stipend and return airfare
scholarships.deadline: April 2027 mein dobara khulengi

scholarships.name: Saudi Government Scholarships (Study in Saudi)
scholarships.who: Non-Saudi students including Pakistanis; age 17-25 for Bachelor, up to 30 Master, up to 35 PhD
scholarships.coverage: Full offers include tuition, stipend, housing, insurance and annual flight (some seats are partial/paid)
scholarships.deadline: April 2027 mein nayi applications expected hain (har university ki date alag ho sakti hai)
